import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long a = 0, b = 0;
        double mn = 214748364.0;
        double t;

        for (long tb = 1; tb <= n; tb++) {
            long ta = (tb * x) / y;
            t = Math.abs(tb * x - ta * y) / (double)(y * (tb + 0.0));
            if (t < mn) {
                a = ta;
                b = tb;
                mn = t;
            }
            ta++;
            t = Math.abs(tb * x - ta * y) / (double)(y * (tb + 0.0));
            if (t < mn) {
                a = ta;
                b = tb;
                mn = t;
            }
        }

        long l = (long) Math.sqrt(Math.max(a, b) + 0.0);
        for (long i = 2; i < l; i++) {
            while (a % i == 0 && b % i == 0) {
                a /= i;
                b /= i;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
